scope: evaluation-only selection of the smallest justified per-domain extraction rule vocabulary before any production rule engine or site-specific rule is implemented

problem_statement.current_extraction_policy: all domains share the same Readability-first, Trafilatura-fallback and heuristic browser-escalation behavior
problem_statement.observed_repository_evidence: no frozen corpus or open issue currently demonstrates a specific real-domain extraction failure
problem_statement.consequence: production selector or browser override semantics must not be chosen by intuition; candidate primitives are evaluated first on deterministic failure-class fixtures

remove_selectors.intent: remove configured DOM subtrees before Readability on both static and rendered HTML
remove_selectors.invalid_selector_behavior: candidate must fail open to the unmodified document during evaluation

content_selector.intent: restrict extraction input to a configured content subtree before Readability
content_selector.missing_match_behavior: fail open to the unmodified document
content_selector.multiple_match_behavior: candidate semantics must be deterministic and frozen by the evaluation report

force_browser.intent: allow an eligible domain rule to request the existing browser extraction path even when the global quality heuristic would accept static extraction
force_browser.browser_disabled_behavior: fall back to the existing static extraction result rather than making extraction fail

fixture_contract.frozen_inputs: all HTML/static-rendered fixture pairs and expected marker sets are committed before candidate scoring

scoring.required_markers: 100% of required content markers must survive
scoring.control_equivalence: clean_control output must remain byte-for-byte identical to the certified baseline when no rule applies

selection_contract.primitive_eligibility: a primitive is eligible only if it converts at least one target fixture class from failing to passing while causing zero clean-control regression
selection_contract.vocabulary_selection: select the smallest set of eligible primitives that covers every fixture class demonstrated to need an override
selection_contract.no_value_outcome: if no primitive produces a preregistered improvement, select no production capability and stop
